issues.on_page: Line 44 Electric Utility 2,576.19 under 'Business-Type Activities', General Fund column
issues.issue: The form prints this row under Business-Type Activities, but the amount is in the General Fund column and the village has no utility fund. Keeping it governmental is defensible (fund-column split), but whether it is utility spending or the village's own electric bill can't be settled from the page. Same for detail[13]. Not listed in decision_needed.

issues.on_page: Line 28 Subtotal of Ending Balances printed '-'; no total-assets line printed
issues.issue: total_assets 0 comes from a dash on the ending-balance subtotal line, not from a printed total-assets figure. Assets (line 26 Net Cash Balance) are blank, while the Ending Balance of 39,928.03 is recorded as equity, so the balance sheet doesn't balance (also in report_discrepancies).

issues.on_page: Line 24 Ending Balance 39,928.03; line 26 Net Cash Balance blank
issues.issue: Ending cash is taken from line 24 Ending Balance because line 26 Net Cash Balance is left blank. This is reasonable for a cash-basis statement, but the cash line itself isn't printed. The County Treasurer balance of 2,332.70 is excluded, which matches the form.
The equity line has no category field.
